mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, as measured by the monthly UNRATE series, indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum, as measured by the monthly FEDFUNDS series, indicates monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (above 95) and retail sales (above 450,000 million dollars), as measured by the monthly INDPRO and RSAFS series, indicates robust economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 95 and RSAFS exceeds 450000, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by strong GDP growth and low unemployment), a CPI index level above 242 signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 > 19000 and UNRATE < 4.8%), CPIAUCSL > 242 is associated with positive SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 240, as measured by the monthly CPIAUCSL series, indicates elevated inflation that pressures central banks to tighten monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls above 100,000 thousand, as measured by the monthly PAYEMS series, indicates strong labor market growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 100000.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in housing starts above 1100 and unemployment rate decline below 4.8%, as measured by the monthly HOUST and UNRATE series, indicates robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1100 and UNRATE falls below 4.8%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 95), a decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdown periods (INDPRO < 95), SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
